statements.t: In light of an evolving landscape in PROC, we plan to discuss the DENALI data with the FDA in 2027 to assess the accelerated approval opportunity.
With DENALI Part 2c enrollment completing this month, we expect a topline readout from DENALI in the first half of 2027 — a key potential value-creating catalyst ahead of ASPENOVA.

“With $228.9 million on the balance sheet providing an anticipated runway into the first half of 2028, we believe we are well resourced to support key DENALI milestones, full enrollment in ASPENOVA and combination trials in ovarian cancer and triple-negative breast cancer,” Ms.
Focused on translating WEE1 science into clinical practice, we aim to equip physicians with a targeted, non-chemo, orally available medicine that enhances treatment experience, choice, and outcomes.
